name: Silver Bullet (time-based FVG)
source: ICT's later public teaching (2022 onward). Not part of the 2016 course in this app: check the details against ICT's own material.
summary: Inside one of three one-hour windows, wait for a displacement that leaves a fair value gap in the direction of the draw on liquidity, and enter on the return into that gap.
steps: Before the window, know the draw on liquidity: the nearest obvious high or low price is likely to reach.
Inside the window, look for a sweep of nearby liquidity, then a displacement toward the draw.
The displacement must leave a fair value gap.
Enter on the retracement into the FVG.
Take profit at the draw on liquidity; skip it if there isn't enough room.
entry: Limit order in the fair value gap formed during the window.
stop: Beyond the swing that created the gap.
target: The draw on liquidity identified before the window.
invalidation: No FVG forms inside the window, or price closes through the gap against you.
checklist: The draw on liquidity was marked before the window
The FVG formed inside the 03–04, 10–11 or 14–15 New York window
A displacement created the FVG, in the direction of the draw
Nearby liquidity was swept first (optional, stronger)
There's enough room to the target for at least 2:1
